_readme: The ONLY place the bot takes downloadable files from.
Add titles you own, produced, or have an explicit distribution licence for.
The bot never invents a download link: if a title is missing here it says
'No direct download available' and shows legal streaming options instead.
The two entries shipped below are genuinely free to share:
Sintel (2010) and Tears of Steel (2012) - Blender Foundation,
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Replace them with your own catalogue.
id        unique string (optional, defaults to title)
aliases   alternative spellings users may type
rating    your own rating 0-10 (TMDB rating overrides when available)
offers[]  quality, url, sizeBytes, type: direct|stream|page
type=direct  -> real file (video/* or octet-stream): auto video/document send
type=page    -> landing page: link only, never auto-downloaded

movies.title: Sintel
movies.synopsis: A lone young woman crosses a hostile world to find the dragon she once raised. Blender Foundation's open movie, released under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.synopsis: A group of warriors and scientists gather in Amsterdam to prevent a robot uprising. Blender Foundation open movie, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.
